eye.interpretation: QC only; uncalibrated pupil area; missing or interpolated pupil is not sleep

biopac.format: sparse positive pulse sample list; group consecutive high timestamps within 100ms

clock_rule: raw ordered R128 = volume0..N-1; event urevent links + exact clean_sample_mask; eye task clock nearest <=50ms; BIOPAC ordered pulses relative to first <=40ms
volume_drop_rule: zero; pinned released CCS wrapper numDropping=0; raw and processed 288 volumes in pilot

channel_bridge.method: MNE accurate spherical spline; source SET donor directions and VU target directions on95mm sphere, fixed origin0
channel_bridge.reason: additional source-cleaned electrodes missing; policy specified from channel metadata before reserved outcome arrays
channel_bridge.reference: original source reference retained; no reference harmonization

EEG_spectral_QC.interpretation: descriptive corrected EEG amplitude/spectrum; does not prove absence of residual MR/BCG artifacts

motion_QC.method: AFNI six parameters degrees/mm; Power FD, 50mm radius

labels_in_model_order: Superior temporal sulcus with angular gyrus
Superior parts of Postcentral and Precentral gyri
target_extraction.global_mask: nonzero temporal support of released MNI no-GSR volume, temporal sd>1e-8
target_extraction.normalization: full-run demean + absolute 95th percentile scaling; retrospective target definition
target_extraction.released_processing: CCS 24 motion parameters + WM/CSF; no GSR/no temporal filter/no smoothing; no extra nuisance regression

causal_context: 24s feature history lies in one physical segment; zero-phase segment filtering, source artifact/ICA cleanup, full-run target filtering and normalization are retrospective; no online-causal claim
